failure_mode: Pump trips on high vibration during processing
effect: Chamber down 36 h; wafers in process scrapped; lots re-routed
cause: Bearing wear accelerating with run hours
current_controls: Fixed-interval pump swap; vibration trip interlock only
recommended_action: Daily refit of ODE wear model; schedule pump swap at 5th-percentile forecast minus 1 day

effect: Missed or false SPC signals; wrong capability numbers
recommended_action: Automated SQL extraction with range checks and de-duplication; data-quality report each run

effect: Etch rate drifts low; wafers fall below LSL
cause: Chiller refrigerant loss / fouled heat exchanger
recommended_action: Trend chuck temperature against its own control limits; X-bar chart rules 2-4 catch slow drift

effect: Etch rate shifts high; Cpk falls below 1.33
cause: Valve not re-zeroed during PM; no post-PM check
recommended_action: Add valve calibration step to PM checklist; post-PM qualification wafers; Western Electric rules on X-bar chart

effect: About 3% of wafers out of spec at the old recipe
cause: Recipe window not optimised (RF power x temperature interaction)
recommended_action: DOE re-centred recipe: RF 1428 W / 32 mTorr / 55 C
Rate-of-change alarm on gas flow; MFC zero check at PM
Add RF power to sensor SPC; quarterly calibration
